text:
maria (oncall): apiserver 503s in ap-south1 right now — started ~03:02 UTC, looks correlated with a GPU attach surge

james (infra): seeing same. apiserver latency + 503s. proxy logs show lots of conn resets and SNAT errors. @dino any rolling attach jobs?

dino (provisioner): started a bulk attach to empty GPU pools at 03:00 UTC — autoscaler kicked and we hit a wave of attach pods. rolling that out for 15m windows. pausing now.

anita (sre): pasting a quick snippet from control-plane proxy logs: 
```
Mar 12 03:03:12 proxy-01 kube-proxy[2345]: conntrack: conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Mar 12 03:03:13 apiserver kube-apiserver[4567]: 503 Service Unavailable: dial tcp 10.12.5.8:6443: connect: connection refused
Mar 12 03:03:15 proxy-01 kube-proxy[2345]: SNAT pool exhausted for node egress
```

ben (network): confirmed — NAT ephemeral ports / SNAT IP count hit hard. We have a planned headroom of ~20% but this surge exceeded it. No upstream peering change.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation: pause attach (thx @dino), scale attach workers to 10% and drain new attach pods from region, increase SNAT IPs if possible.

dino (provisioner): pausing rollout now. running: 
```sh
kubectl label node -l gpu-attach=rolling attach-disabled=true --overwrite
# scale attach controller
kubectl scale deploy/gpu-attach-controller -n infra --replicas=2
```

deploy-bot: rollback request accepted for deployment gpu-attach-rollout/2026-03-12T03:00Z — started

james (infra): also enabling per-node egress throttling so single node doesn't blast the NAT. patch: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  egress-rate: "50r/s"
```

anita (sre): monitoring: apiserver 5xx rate down from 18/min -> 2/min after pause, control-plane CPU normalized. keeping a watch for 15m.

ben (network): provisioning +1 SNAT IP to ap-south1, ETA 4m. if we see repeated surges we need to increase pool baseline.

maria (oncall): current plan: 1) finish rollback + pause attaches 2) add SNAT capacity 3) re-run attach with slower ramp (5/min) and attach-worker rate limit 4) add a permanent runbook entry for heavy attach windows.

dino (provisioner): agreed. will open a PR with rate-limited attach controller and default backoff. cc: @anita for runbook text.

anita (sre): action items logged: 
- short: pause rollout, add SNAT IP, throttle attach workers (in progress)
- med: PR for attach rate-limits + egress per-node cap (dino)
- long: capacity planning for NAT headroom during fleet onboarding (infra+network)

maria (oncall): nice containment. keeping channel open until 03:17 UTC. please post when full rollback completes.

dino (provisioner): rollback complete, attach controller at 2 replicas. will push rate-limit PR in ~30m.

anita (sre): confirm: apiserver 503s dropped to baseline, no more conntrack errors in last 90s. closing incident unless it recurs. :thumbsup:
